value.name: reveal original was given away
value.description: Daniel learns that the original document was given to her rather than kept in the file.

value.name: Daniel accuses malpractice
value.description: Daniel reacts strongly, calling the decision to give away the original malpractice.

value.name: Asha defends unusual request
value.description: Asha explains that the act was unusual but not necessarily malpractice because it was done at her request.
evidence: "It is unusual. It is not, by itself, malpractice. It was at her request."

value.name: locate original in house
value.description: Asha suggests the original may still be in the house and that they need to search for it.
evidence: "So the original is in this house."
"Possibly. Or it was. We need to look."

value.name: Daniel reports exhaustive search
value.description: Daniel says he has already searched every drawer in the house and found no codicil.
evidence: "I have been through every drawer in this house. There is no codicil."

value.name: Asha absorbs Daniel's claim
value.description: Asha lets Daniel's statement hang in the silence while Lucia watches her brother.
evidence: Asha let that sit in the air.
